signal.long_vol: gamma_flow_balance > 0 => BUY ATM call + BUY ATM put
signal.short_vol: gamma_flow_balance < 0 => SELL ATM call + SELL ATM put

instrument_selection.strike_choice: nearest strike to 12:00 underlying, same strike call+put

execution.entry: first valid two-sided BBO at/after 12:00 and <=12:05; buy at ask, sell at bid
execution.exit: first valid two-sided BBO at/after 23:55 and before 24:00; close long at bid, close short at ask
execution.missing_leg_or_quote: exclude date fail-closed; never widen windows

cost_model.fee_basis: BTC underlying per option contract, capped at 12.5% of option value
cost_model.rationale: positions are closed by public BBO before expiry; no delivery

stress.additional_slippage: one additional contemporaneous bid-ask spread per leg across the round trip, applied adversely and never improving a fill

bootstrap.statistic: mean net BTC PnL per straddle episode

no_rescue_rule: After execution outcomes open, do not alter sign rule, zero threshold, DTE range, expiry/strike selection, amount, entry/exit windows, BBO side, fee/cap, stress model, sample gates, economic gates or years under this MVE ID.
trigger_rule: No runner may execute until both required parent classifications are verified from canonical immutable artifacts.
